name: vision_video3d_bad
title: The same video classifier with eight planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_video3d

expected.defect: VideoNet.forward ends in nn.LogSoftmax while the objective is nn.CrossEntropyLoss
expected.why: cross entropy log-softmaxes its input again, so the effective target distribution is wrong and the loss barely moves

expected.defect: the same double log-softmax on the evaluation path
expected.why: the reported validation loss is on a different scale from any comparable run
a 0.5 Dropout and BatchNorm3d on every stage mean the reported accuracy is a random under-estimate and the validation clips overwrite the running statistics

expected.defect: the training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: clips are listed class folder by class folder, so every batch is one action class

expected.defect: the training clips are never moved to the device the model was moved to
expected.why: a CPU tensor fed to a CUDA module raises at the first forward

expected.defect: evaluate() is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: a 3D convolutional graph over sixteen frames is built for every validation clip and dropped

expected.defect: MultiStepLR, an epoch schedule with milestones at 20 and 35, is stepped inside the batch loop
expected.why: both milestones are passed in the first thirty-five batches, so the whole run trains at one hundredth of the intended learning rate

expected.defect: one CLIP_TRANSFORM with RandomResizedCrop and RandomHorizontalFlip is used for all three splits
expected.why: the validation and test clips are randomly cropped and flipped, so the reported accuracy moves between epochs

forbidden.why: the evaluation loaders still pass shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() is still called every batch
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
the running loss still accumulates loss.item()
clip_grad_norm_ still sits between backward() and step()
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the three splits are still three directories
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()
the stage list is still an nn.ModuleList
torch.save still writes the state_dict() and torch.load still passes weights_only=True

gaps.what: _start_index draws a random clip offset for every split, so the same validation video is a different clip each epoch and the validation curve measures clip sampling rather than the model - no rule covers split-dependent sampling written inside a Dataset
gaps.evidence: clips.py:57-62 against the clean twin's centre-clip branch

gaps.what: the two evaluation loaders pass drop_last=True, so up to seven videos per split are silently omitted from the reported accuracy (MLV113 is later-tier)
